panel.name: panel_performance_nearby
panel.text: Oculte los avatares más complejos para aumentar la velocidad.

slider.name: IndirectMaxComplexity
slider.label: Maximum complexity (K)
slider.tool_tip: Controls at what point a visually complex avatar is drawn as a Impostor

slider.name: FSRenderAvatarMaxART
slider.label: Tiempo de renderizado máximo (μs)
slider.tool_tip: Controla cuándo se considera que un avatar visualmente complejo tarda demasiado en renderizar (unidad: microsegundos)

name_list.columns.name: art_visual
name_list.columns.tool_tip: Bar graph showing current render time (includes auto-tuning) as % of slowest.

name_list.columns.name: art_value
name_list.columns.label: Tiempo (μs)
name_list.columns.tool_tip: Avatar Render Time. Actual time taken to render this avatar before any auto-tuning (in microseconds).

name_list.columns.name: adj_art_value
name_list.columns.label: Adj. Time (μs)
name_list.columns.tool_tip: Avatar Render Time. Actual time taken to render this avatar after adjustments (in microseconds).

name_list.columns.name: state
name_list.columns.tool_tip: Shows any tuning. I=Impostor, S=no shadow.

name_list.columns.name: breakdown
name_list.columns.label: Breakdown
name_list.columns.tool_tip: Where the rendering time is spent (Geom/Shad/Other)

panel.text: También puede hacer clic derecho en un avatar en el mundo para controlar la visualización.
Note: Your own avatar includes viewer overheads. Use the attachment tab to see how you affect others.
